scope: One bounded SmolLM3 family announcement, not first weights dates, API availability or global coverage.

title.zh: Hugging Face SmolLM3 Base / Instruct-reasoning 家族公告
title.en: Hugging Face SmolLM3 Base / Instruct-reasoning family announcement

summary.zh: 官方博客标注 2025-07-08，链接 SmolLM3-3B-Base 与 SmolLM3-3B；后者合并指令与推理双模式，不是另一个 reasoning 权重事件。作者描述 3B 文本模型、六种主要语言、64k 训练上下文及通过 YaRN 外推至 128k；不把外推长度写成训练长度。公告时刻与时区未登记。
summary.en: The blog dated July 8, 2025 links SmolLM3-3B-Base and SmolLM3-3B. The latter combines instruction and reasoning modes, not a separate reasoning weights event. Authors describe 3B text models, six main languages, 64k training context and YaRN extrapolation to 128k; extrapolated length is not training length. Publication time and timezone are unrecorded.

note.zh: 一条家族公告，不是首次权重公开日期。Transformers 文档的 2025-06-25 是代码贡献日期，不是模型公告日（https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/model_doc/smollm3）。截至 2026-11-02 的成员卡元数据标注 8 languages，正文明确六种主要语言：英语、法语、西班牙语、德语、意大利语、葡萄牙语；不能推断八种语言同等级支持。当前卡片 Apache-2.0 不证明公告日历史许可，也不自动证明完整开源。卡片提示可能有事实错误、逻辑不一致和偏差。首次完整权重日期、固定修订、历史许可与地区/账户/API 可用性未核实；当前可变页面不是历史快照。未登录、下载权重、运行模型或复现作者评测。
note.en: One family announcement, not a first-public weights date. The Transformers date 2025-06-25 is code contribution, not model announcement (https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/model_doc/smollm3). Member cards checked 2026-11-02 show 8 languages in metadata but six main languages in prose: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian and Portuguese; this does not establish equal support for eight. Current Apache-2.0 labels do not prove historical license applicability or fully open-source AI. Cards warn of factual errors, inconsistency and bias. First complete weights dates, pinned revisions, historical licensing and regional/account/API access remain unverified; mutable current pages are not historical snapshots. No login, weights download, model execution or reproduction of author evaluations.
